name: peek-rating

frames.best_why: Four stars are lit, the row lifts toward the cursor and the word label floats above the score.

tagline: Stars lift in a wave under the cursor and show a word for the score.
summary: A five-star rating where hovering lights and lifts the stars in a wave while a word label floats above the score. Clicking commits the value and pops the chosen star once.
appearance: Five rounded star icons in a row, grey when unset and warm gold when chosen, on a dark card under a small avatar and a question. A small dark pill label floats above the hovered star.
behaviour: Moving across the row lights stars up to the pointer and raises them in a wave, the nearest star slightly larger with a word label above it. Clicking fixes the score, pops the chosen star, and the label hides again when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Review card asking how a session with Priya went; rating words Not helpful, Okay, Good, Great, Life-changing.
use_when: A product or session needs a friendly one-to-five score with a written label for each step.
avoid_when: It only shows whole-star scores, so half-star or numeric ratings need a different input.
customise: Value, default value, change and preview handlers, count, shape, icon, labels, active and idle colours, tooltip colours, size, lift, magnify, durations, pop, clear and read-only are props.
weight_why: Five inline icons with CSS lifts and one short Web Animations pop on click.

a11y.note: Each star is a radio with a descriptive label and full keyboard support; the hover word tooltip is not announced.

issues: The word for the score only shows during hover, so the committed label disappears once the pointer leaves.
polish_why: Tidy card and a satisfying wave; the grey idle stars are fairly low contrast on the dark card.
